title: GET - MEP
desc:
Site (MEP) Coordination & Execution
Sound knowledge in Auto CAD editing
Assist in supervising daily MEP activities on project sites.
Ensure all tasks are completed in line with project schedules and quality standards.
Communicate with consultants, contractors, vendors, and team members to address site challenges.
Planning & Execution
Collaborate with the project team to plan MEP activities.
Track and report progress to ensure milestones are met.
Help identify and resolve technical and operational issues on-site.
Quality Control & Safety
Perform basic quality checks for construction materials and site activities.
Assist in implementing safety measures and maintaining compliance.
Documentation & Reporting
Prepare and update progress reports, schedules, and other project documentation.
